Arrays

Source: R/arrays.R
z3_array.Rd

Z3 arrays are total functions from a domain sort to a range sort, with no length. z3_select(a, i) reads index i; z3_store(a, i, v) is a new array equal to a except that index i maps to v. z3_const_array() maps every index to the same value.

Usage

z3_array(ctx, name, domain, range)

z3_select(a, i, ...)

z3_store(a, i, v)

z3_const_array(domain, value)

z3_array_map(f, ...)

z3_array_default(a)

z3_array_ext(a, b)

z3_as_array(f)

z3_lambda(vars, body)

z3_array_sort_info(x)

Arguments

ctx

A z3_context().

name

Name of the array constant.

domain, range

z3_sort objects for indices (or a list of them) and elements.

a

An array expression.

i

An index (expression or R scalar), or for z3_store() on a multi-index array, a list of indices.

...

Further indices for multi-index arrays, or arrays for z3_array_map().

v

A value (expression or R scalar).

value

The value of every element of a constant array.

f

A z3_function or z3_func_decl.

b

Another array.

vars

A constant or list of constants to bind.

body

An expression.

x

An array expression or array sort.

Value

A z3_expr.

z3_array_sort_info() returns a list with the index sorts (domain) and element sort (range).

Details

Arrays may have several index sorts (give domain as a list; Z3 4.8.15 or later); then z3_select(a, i, j) takes one index per sort and z3_store(a, list(i, j), v) takes the indices as a list.

  • z3_array_map(f, a, b, ...) applies a function pointwise.

  • z3_array_default(a) is the value at all but finitely many indices.

  • z3_array_ext(a, b) is an index at which two different arrays differ.

  • z3_as_array(f) turns a function into an array.

  • z3_lambda(vars, body) builds an array from an expression over bound constants, as in z3_lambda(i, i * i).

Examples

ctx <- z3_context()
a <- z3_array(ctx, "a", z3_int_sort(ctx), z3_int_sort(ctx))
i <- z3_int(ctx, "i")
s <- z3_solver(ctx)
z3_add(s, z3_select(z3_store(a, i, 10), i) != 10)
z3_check(s)
#> [1] "unsat"
zeros <- z3_const_array(z3_int_sort(ctx), 0)
z3_simplify(z3_select(zeros, 5))
#> <z3_expr Int> 0
